remarks: This beautifully renovated, garden style condo boasts a new modern kitchen with quartz countertops, microwave, stylish lighting and a fresh coat of paint in a neutral palette. The spacious living rm/dining rm combo features custom built-ins and new carpeting. Walk out to your private balcony overlooking the well-maintained perennial gardens; a place to enjoy some quiet time. The primary bedroom features a walk-in closet, new carpeting and sliders that bring in plenty of natural light. Oversized multi-purpose storage room (Approx 15x15) provides plenty of storage, your own W/D. Only 28 units, enjoy resort style living spending summers by the pool. 1 reserved parking space with additional guest parking. Convenient to all: minutes to I-95, restaurants, beaches, parks, downtown nightlife, NYC, Chelsea Piers, medical facilities and public transportation. Perfect for 1st time homebuyers, second home, empty nesters and investors. Come see and make this charming condo your home.
